content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Patna Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) for a project-based research position under a MeitY sponsored initiative in the Electrical Engineering Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Patna recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF), with potential progression to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) based on performance and project duration requirements.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Junior Research Fellow position under advertisement number R&D/908/MEM/631 for eligible engineering and science graduates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the filled application form through email is 22-10-2026. Interested candidates must send their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Patna JRF?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates are required to send their scanned application form and supporting documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech, B.Tech, or M.Sc degree in relevant electrical, electronics, communication, instrumentation, or computer science disciplines with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years for M.Tech applicants and 28 years for B.Tech/B.Sc/M.Sc applicants, with permissible relaxations according to GOI rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or fellowship provided?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 37,000 per month for JRF and Rs. 42,000 per month for SRF upon upgrading.

faq.question: Q9. Will selected candidates get an opportunity for a PhD?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates will be admitted to the PhD program in the Electrical Engineering Department at IIT Patna in Spring-2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on applications and GATE scores, followed by a written test and a personal interview scheduled at IIT Patna.
